name: 李畅
title: 多智能体仿真，强化学习，计算机图形学，群体智能
titleEn: Multi-Agent Simulation, Reinforcement Learning, Computer Graphics, Swarm Intelligence
bio: 多智能体仿真、强化学习、计算机图形学与群体智能的交叉研究，旨在理解、建模并重现复杂群体的交互与涌现规律，为大规模智能体在虚拟与现实环境中的自主决策、协同演化和可信仿真提供基础支撑。
bioEn: Interdisciplinary research at the intersection of multi-agent simulation, reinforcement learning, computer graphics, and swarm intelligence, aiming to understand, model, and reproduce the interaction and emergence patterns of complex collectives, providing foundational support for autonomous decision-making, collaborative evolution, and trustworthy simulation of large-scale agents in virtual and real environments.
description: 李畅的个人学术主页：研究、论文、项目、写作和随笔。
descriptionEn: Chang Li's personal academic homepage: research, papers, projects, writing, and essays.
